notes.title: Dev Update - Progress Report On Trailer, Timeline & Testing
notes.content: [h2]Trailer[/h2][p]The main launch trailer is in active production and coming together nicely. I’ve been working on pacing, voice-over, and cinematic sequences that highlight the unique hybrid gameplay of [i]Artificial Extinction 2[/i]. The goal is to capture the tension of defending your base under siege while also showing the flexibility of toggling instantly between 'Battle Architect' top-down strategy and first-person combat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41901368/76984941a0f407e61232c4be54e4bdbe4215d9a0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I'm excited to share it with you and will let you know as soon as it's released. Here are some 'secret' screenshots I snuck out to share with you!  ;)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41901368/0bd7a4334b5620c9d4ebbb1e1edbeb1475a62931.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Demo and Timeline[/h2][p]If all goes smoothly, I hope to have a Demo for you guys to try out mid-November. I'm really looking forward to your feedback. The best way I know what to focus on improving is by listening to you. Game development could go on forever with new features - but it's almost time to share it with you. My goal is to keep improving it after launch, adding new maps, challenges, and leaderboard competitions. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41901368/2f83a08764c7fbd4159a3e5a8d2d127b6957efd9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For the Full Launch, I'm aiming Spring 2026. The full launch version will include 10 maps, the Test Range and 4 game modes (Campaign, Nightmare, TD only & FPS only). Replayability is a major focus so each time you attempt a level, it will be a little different. Enemy attack patterns, resource locations and weapon station locations will all vary each time you play. [/p][p][/p][h2]Testing[/h2][p]Currently, the demo is being tested by 10 different Localizers from around the world. They're checking the language translations throughout the build, both written and spoken. They're already providing feedback and I'm implementing their corrections. They're also testing the game play and I've had some very encouraging comments. They're having fun! As a developer, that's the most encouraging thing I can hear - knowing that the vision is actually delivering enjoyment.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41901368/0870f82b81d3f0e4a531be65dd6828c02512e8c1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Please don't forget to Wishlist Artificial Extinction 2 - it really helps support the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for checking out my game and I hope you try the Demo![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Gearing Up for the Demo – A Behind-the-Scenes Update
notes.content:
[h1]Dev Update – Artificial Extinction 2 Progress Report[/h1][p]
Hi everyone,

Just wanted to take a moment to share what I’ve been working on with [b]Artificial Extinction 2[/b]. As a solo developer, I’ve been putting in some seriously long days — building, testing, refining — doing everything I can to make sure this game is something truly worth your time.

Here’s a quick look at what’s been happening behind the scenes:

- Completed the [b]full tutorial[/b] — streamlined, clear, and fully playable  
- Finalized a complete [b]campaign level[/b] for the upcoming [b]demo![/b]  
- Refined the [b]Test Range[/b] to allow players to experiment freely  
- Added unlockable demo-exclusive modes: [b]Nightmare, FPS-only, and RTS-only[/b]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41901368/c292cdd69c37db85f032072d4db4c73bd2df73de.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h1]Localization & Global Players[/h1][p]
One of the biggest efforts lately has been [b]localizing the game into 10 languages[/b], including:

French, German, Spanish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Ukrainian

Every UI element, tutorial prompt, and menu item is being carefully translated to make sure players around the world can jump in and enjoy the experience on day one — and it's all being done by hand, with care.

[/p][h1]Demo Leaderboards[/h1][p]
The upcoming demo will include [b]Steam Leaderboards[/b], allowing players to compare their performance and survival time with others. Whether you're trying to beat your friends or climb the global rankings, there's plenty of opportunity for some friendly competition.

We're also exploring the idea of running [b]small leaderboard contests[/b] (such as "High Score of the Month") — with fun rewards like Steam gift cards. More on that soon!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41901368/2111a5c969cdce163edab83ba689bd3cae466315.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]What’s Coming Up[/h1][p]
- A [b]private Steam Playtest[/b] which will be invite-only to gather early feedback  
- Final tweaks, polish, and balancing  of the demo
- Preparing the [b]official demo[/b] build for [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]

[/p][h1]Thank You[/h1][p]
Thanks so much for your support, your wishlists, and your encouragement. It’s what keeps me going through the long hours and late nights. I’m incredibly excited to share this game with you, and I can’t wait to see what you think.

More updates soon. Stay tuned.

– Chris  
Developer of [b]Artificial Extinction 2[/b]
[/p]

notes.title: Early Testing Has Begun!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Greetings![/b][/h1]

After 1 year of work, the current build has the basics implemented and is playable. It's been a long road to get to this point and there's still a long way to go but it's a big milestone to celebrate!

We've added 'Power Towers' which provide energy to all your equipment. The player must build equipment within the power range of the Towers for them to work. Here's how they look in the game now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41901368/4f951b2a3177eeb17f850e4a2992e17777924f14.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41901368/197a2c7563916ecc2bbd9ab118fc185702323c99.jpg[/img]

The concept was a suggestion from the community and it adds a lot to the feeling of progression, expansion and enjoyment of the game. 

Early testing has also already added another cool feature. Building equipment is done from a 'top-down' point of view which is really efficient but one hurdle is knowing the Turrets 'line-of-sight' when you're placing it. The terrain isn't always flat and it's possible to place the Turret with an obstructed view. The solution is to add a 'view-port' overlay that shows the Turrets 'pov' as it's being placed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41901368/873b6df3a529bd274188087cf1f3db0da0186e29.jpg[/img]

To help the community become more involved with the features of the game, I've created a Trello board that allows players to vote on features, see what I'm working on and what's left to be done. I'll do my best to keep it updated. Check it out here:  https://trello.com/b/9SOPwuDB/artificial-extinction-2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41901368/a933ef33dd2eddb04cac82f87d0110c799b4f573.jpg[/img]

Replayability is a priority so the game is being designed to include features such as different game modes, maps, biomes, challenges and a player customizable level. 

Please join us on Discord, get involved in active development and help me bring this concept to it's fullest potential: https://discord.gg/p62Afqr

[h2]Cheers![/h2]

notes.title: AE2 Development Update #2 - Dropship, Drones and Troops!
notes.content:
[h1][i][b]Greetings![/b][/i][/h1]

Development has been going very well, we are working on more complicated features that take more time to code. One of them will be featured today! Thanks to all the valuable feedback the community has given us, it's been very beneficial towards the development process. 

[h2][b]Dropship, Drones and Troops[/b][/h2]

The Dropship concept gives the Mechs the ability to call in re-inforcements upon engagement. The way it works is that the Mech can signal for support, drop a smoke grenade to mark a landing spot and a Dropship will fly in and deliver up to 8 Ground Troops at a time. Currently there is only one mech that can do this, the Scout Mech, but depending on how testing will go, this can definitely change!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/64a64923f493e166de908e2afa6d50995649ab35.jpg[/img]

Currently, there are 3 different types of Ground Troops, each with their own behavior. The Sniper will engage at a farther distance and behave more cautiously. The Machine Gunner will engage at a medium distance and not advance too close. The Assault soldier will behave most agressively and advance with a sacrificial behavior. These troops may distract your Turrets from the more valuable Mechs in a strategic move to overwhelm your defenses. While individually these won't prove too much of a threat, in groups they can be devastating if unchallenged!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/6d1bb341781a7eb7d9247c617fcac41f2a094c87.jpg[/img]

There are three enemy drone classes each with their own weapon system and threat level. First you will encounter the lower level drones, but as time goes on expect to suffer the more powerful drones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/7af253e62fd0df3f3e2676bb227d208672d13aa7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/1b6c47592c0b87f74ffbdabca24d20cc0a05bbb3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/ab127287b2c2cb02d4775afee85477b3082e9fc5.jpg[/img]

All these enemies! Time to start working on the vast arsenal you will have to combat this army of enemy AI. This 'Emergency Drone' is on your side. Feel like your being overrun? Need some backup? This emergency drone is extremely powerful and devastating, but it's also got it's disadvantages such as long reload time as well needing lots of Tech upgrades to perform it's best!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/755f993485482350b5f5349ffe97c48d0ac8720e.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]What's Next?[/b][/h2]

Turrets, turrets and more turrets. With such a vast array of enemy classes, you will need just as equal a variety of weaponry to defend against their attacks. Initially quite basic, there will be many upgradable features on each Turret to transform them into efficient machines of destruction. There are currently plans for up to 8 different turrets all with differing roles on the battlefield. Keep in mine, it's still early in development and anything can change!

If you would like early sneak peaks at what we work on before the monthly post, join our discord to see them!

Thanks again for all of your support and suggestions!

Discord link: https://discord.gg/p62Afqr

[h3][i][b]Until Next Time![/b][/i][/h3]

notes.title: AE2 Development Update #1 - Mechs and Armour System!
notes.content:
[h1][i][b]Greetings![/b][/i][/h1]

We're migrating the Development Updates to this store page and will continue to post them here. 

[h2][b]Mechs and Drones[/b][/h2]

Here is a summary of the Mech's specifications to date. Don't think these are final though, we can't stop them from evolving so expect them to be deadlier by the time you meet them. In fact, the deadliest Mech has just been discovered, check out the new Level 4 Rocket Mech!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/88cfc1f116dd16e3397a68e1acea3a2255c8eb7c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/4fb85edaefdf93711a505cecf85cf47fa218768a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/7ff5d15cabd2557c34feb930ccabea75e7f33bcb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/1736b54359802c40db9bc543e5ecc55450bb389a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/011f53cb25ad15462a3fc2f7af5ae9e2b90937fb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/80b16cffecfbde02d5e33b230e68c5b37f5bbb82.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/947112515150dc62a57321bb32ff205a97e124cc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/2c776cb0eeaabc8fe67bf27991beb486bb017b88.jpg[/img]

We have designated all of the Mechs into different levels based on their difficulty. At the moment, there are 4 levels. As the levels go up, the difficulty and sophistication of enemies increase. The Scouts are the basic enemy you encounter at the start of a game, so it'll be the easiest to deal with! But towards the end of the game, you'll meet enemies like the well rounded Battle Mech, which are universally strong and have a wide array of weaponry. So far, it is the most dangerous of the mechs as of yet. However, while it is well rounded, it doesn't excel at specific tasks like breaking shields like the Laser Mech can.

The new drones are functional but their weaponry has not yet been added. We will talk more about Drones on a later date once they are more developed. 

[h2][b]Armour and Shields[/b][/h2]

As described on the Mech Spec Sheets, their defenses are broken down into categories Shields, Armour and Health.  Turrets and enemies will both have this system. As of right now, shields take more damage from energy weapons. Armour absorbs more heavy damage and non-energy weapons and health is the primary health bar on which everything survives. As of right now, all of this is still in development and can change at any point!

[h2][b]What's Next?[/b][/h2]

Hard at work developing individual Mech abilities! For example, the Scout Mech can now expel a smoke 
 grenade that acts as a beacon to bring in reinforcement ground troops. We aim to create abilities like this for all of the Mechs, to make each one unique and a completely different challenge from the other!

Discord link: https://discord.gg/p62Afqr

[h3][i][b]Until Next Time![/b][/i][/h3]
